runtime_contract: Direct native indices are entrance group bases. The engine may choose only the four ordinary child/day, child/night, adult/day, adult/night rows for randomized arrivals.
Preserve the source native entrance identifier for the adult-spawn and OGC-fairy aliases; native initialization copies their four reviewed template rows.
When AP entrance routing is active, repair the child rows of all five adult temple blue warps from their ordinary warp pads before checking resolved scene/spawn facts.
Randomized scene-load setup selection must not inherit a previous cutscene index; normal story-triggered cutscenes remain separate from randomized destination selection.
Runtime age checks use child bit 1 and adult bit 2 explicitly; native LINK_AGE enum ordinals have the opposite order.
Coupled returns remain map[reverse(destination)] == reverse(source). Shared interior source ages are both; generation checks actual age reachability for forbidden arrivals.
